legitimateExplanations.title: A long unplanned stop in a high-risk area.
legitimateExplanations.actually: A breakdown, traffic incident, border queue or enforced congestion stop, none of which the driver chose.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Correlate with breakdown and incident reports and with traffic data for the corridor before treating a stop as a policy breach.

legitimateExplanations.title: Curtain damage at delivery.
legitimateExplanations.actually: Accidental damage from loading equipment or road debris, which is common on soft-sided equipment.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Compare the cut geometry and location with the load plan, and verify against seal and count records whether anything is actually missing.

legitimateExplanations.title: A loaded trailer is left at an unsecured location during a driver change or delay.
legitimateExplanations.actually: A site closure, legally required rest, breakdown or documented relay where no loss occurred.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Verify the instruction, coupling status, CCTV or receipt and the trailer condition at the next controlled handover before treating the stop as theft evidence.

countermeasures.text: Geofence certified secure parking areas and alert on any rest period taken outside them.
Report immediately with the precise stop location and time window, since recovery and investigation both depend on narrowing these.
